evidence.locator: 1306 x 1133 px over 2.39 × 2.07 arcmin; MIRI 7.7, 11.3, 12 and 18 µm (the page prints the second as 1.13 µm); released 12 July 2022. The file's embedded sky tags for scale and direction, 0.1099 arcsec per pixel and north 124.65° right of vertical, and the star for place: the middle of the bright central star's saturated pixels, pixel 663.3, 553.5, is set at SIMBAD's place for NGC 3132, so the frame's centre is 151.7566982°, -40.4364794°. The tags alone put the star 0.29 arcsec away.
